boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten documented no-cost activities at RPI and in Troy, including seasonal public splash pads and library services.

cards.title: Cool off at South Troy Pool Splash Pad
cards.subtitle: South Troy Pool, 4th Street between Tyler and Harrison
cards.notes: Bring water and a towel, then use the city-run splash pad during its posted summer hours. Check the city page before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A city splash-pad stop with documented free admission.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Troy lists South Troy Pool as a splash-pad location and states that admission is free at all City-operated splash pads.
cards.access_notes: Seasonal; the city lists this splash pad as open daily from noon to 7 p.m. Confirm operating status before visiting.

cards.title: Meet by the Riverfront splash pad
cards.subtitle: William Chamberlain Riverfront Park, 255 Front Street
cards.notes: Use the riverfront splash pad as a daytime meet-up point, then follow posted park rules and pack out anything you bring.
cards.short_summary: A free city splash-pad stop beside the Hudson River.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Troy lists William Chamberlain Riverfront Park as a splash-pad location and states that admission is free at all City-operated splash pads.
cards.access_notes: Seasonal; the city lists this splash pad as open daily from noon to 7 p.m. Confirm operating status before visiting.

cards.notes: Make this a quick outdoor reset with friends; use the splash pad only during the city’s listed seasonal operating window.

cards.evidence_claim: The City of Troy lists Corliss Park as a splash-pad location and states that admission is free at all City-operated splash pads.
cards.access_notes: Seasonal; the city lists Corliss Park’s splash pad as open from dawn to dusk.

cards.entity_name: Troy Public Library Main Library Free Wireless Access
cards.title: Use free Wi-Fi at the Main Library
cards.subtitle: Troy Public Library Main Library, 100 Second Street
cards.notes: Bring your own device and headphones, connect during normal library hours, and avoid sending sensitive information over public wireless.
cards.short_summary: Public, no-cost wireless access at Troy’s Main Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Troy Public Library provides free, unfiltered wireless access for the public at its Main Library.
cards.source_title: Free Wireless Access | Troy Public Library
cards.access_notes: Available during normal library operating hours; use is subject to the library’s internet and computer policies.

cards.subtitle: Troy Public Library Lansingburgh Branch

cards.access_notes: Available during normal library operating hours; use is subject to the library’s internet and computer policies.

cards.title: Pick a Kanopy movie with your library card
cards.subtitle: Troy Public Library digital service
cards.notes: Log in with an eligible Troy Public Library card, choose a film, and plan a shared watch without buying or renting a title.
cards.short_summary: Free streaming access for Troy Public Library patrons.
cards.evidence_claim: Troy Public Library states that Kanopy is free for all library patrons and supplies 20 tickets per month plus unlimited Kanopy Kids streaming.
cards.source_title: Introducing Kanopy at TPL | Troy Public Library
cards.access_notes: Requires a Troy Public Library card and a Kanopy account; ticket limits apply to most films.

cards.title: Join EMPAC’s free Community BBQ
cards.subtitle: EMPAC East Campus Entrance, September 5, 2026 at noon
cards.notes: Arrive at the East Campus Entrance for the scheduled gathering and treat it as a one-time event; no purchase or admission is required.
cards.short_summary: A public EMPAC gathering with food provided at no charge.
cards.evidence_claim: EMPAC identifies the September 5, 2026 TOPOS Community BBQ as free and open to all.
cards.access_notes: One-time event: Saturday, September 5, 2026 at noon at the East Campus Entrance; EMPAC lists it as free and open to all.
